question: How is the sovereign goddess of the kula satisfied in relation to the suns?
premises: The sovereign goddess of the kula is satisfied.
The offering involves the honey of the head of the suns.
inference: The practitioner satisfies Kuleśvarī with the head-honey associated with the suns.
uncertainties: The exact ritual referent of śīrṣamadhunā is context-dependent.
plain_english: I satisfy the sovereign goddess of the kula with the head-honey of the suns.
